title: CircuitBreaker
author: Martin Fowler
why: A short, clear walkthrough of the pattern with code, including the half-open reset and why breakers should be monitored.

title: Release It! Design and Deploy Production-Ready Software (2nd edition)
author: Michael T. Nygard (Pragmatic Bookshelf)
why: The book that popularised circuit breakers, alongside timeouts, bulkheads and fail fast, told through real production failures.

title: Resilience4j CircuitBreaker
author: Resilience4j documentation
why: The exact meaning and defaults of failure-rate and slow-call thresholds, count- and time-based windows, minimum calls and half-open trials.

title: Outlier detection
author: Envoy documentation
why: How a proxy ejects individual bad hosts (for example after consecutive 5xx responses) instead of cutting off a whole service.
